field.speaker: explainer
field.text: 「这次是经阴道子宫全切，不像开腹手术那样先在肚子上开切口。我们会从阴道这一侧暴露宫颈，沿宫颈周围的层次逐步分离、处理支持结构和子宫血管，再经阴道把子宫取出，最后检查止血并关闭阴道残端。膀胱和直肠都靠得很近，整个过程中会仔细辨认和保护。至于你清醒时可能会有什么感觉，等麻醉方式选定后我们再确认。」

bowel.speaker: patient
bowel.text: 「天、天哪……真的要从那里切进去开刀呀？！明明我也知道什么叫经阴道手术，可轮到自己……坂口，完了，我连那里的解剖结构都要被你看得一清二楚了……别、别笑！我是在认真问啦！……还有，旁边不是膀胱和直肠吗？是不是也要把肠子推到一边去？」

bowel_answer.speaker: explainer
bowel_answer.text: 「不需要像开腹手术那样，先把肠管大范围移开来建立腹部术野。这次主要经阴道、沿宫颈周围的层次操作；仍然要注意深部与腹腔的关系，尤其要保护膀胱和直肠。具体到牵拉、压迫会感觉多少，要看你接下来选的麻醉方式。我们会在开始前再和你确认。」

bladder.speaker: patient
bladder.text: 「……所以不是先把肠子推上去，而是要从宫颈前面慢慢分开膀胱呀……这一步我以前也跟患者解释过，听起来明明很普通。可现在换别人告诉我，等会儿从那里放器械、要被牵引的是我自己的宫颈……怎么光是想想就这么害怕呀！」

manipulator.speaker: explainer
manipulator.text: 「经阴道入路主要会用器械夹持宫颈、向下牵引，必要时调整方向，让前后方的层次逐步显露出来；不是从下面把子宫直接向上托高。膀胱会沿正确的层次推离，直肠也需要保护。你平时熟悉这些步骤，但今天是你自己接受手术。有不明白或担心的地方，现在可以继续问。」

reaction_lines.explain_plan: “I've been the doctor explaining procedures, so I know the general routine. But today I'm the one on the table... Tell me where you start, what the crucial steps are, and what I might feel if I'm awake. Properly, please.”
reaction_lines.brief_plan: “Mm, I've got the procedure. Such a short explanation—worried I'll start quizzing you? Hehe... Just don't skip the checks that matter. I'll make a proper anesthesia choice when we get to that step.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “...I know you’ll carefully check every step of the procedure you’re actually doing today. Sakaguchi, don’t leave me alone with my imagination, okay?”
reaction_lines.choose_general: “General anesthesia, huh... So I close my eyes, and when I open them, it'll all be over? Shame I'll miss the whole thing... But I'll go with that this time. You'll have to tell me all about it when I wake up.”
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: “An epidural, then. So I'll still be awake to hear you all talking? Hehe, that sounds rather like my kind of thing. But if the block doesn't cover enough, tell me plainly what the plan is, okay?”
reaction_lines.choose_local: “Local anesthesia? Mm... At least I won't sleep through it. But that only numbs the area around the incision, right? Tell me what I might feel deeper in, before I get a nasty surprise.”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “...No anesthesia again? You really did choose the bold option, Sakaguchi. All right, we agreed, so I'll try... But let me make one thing clear: if I scream my head off, you're not allowed to complain!”
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: “Mm... I know. Just breathe slowly. Hey, Sakaguchi... when I wake up, you'd better be...”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “Stop asking whether I'm just trying to act tough! I know it hurts—last time wasn't a dream... Knowing that doesn't stop me from being scared when I'm actually waiting for you to cut.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: “Ah, wait... I know I have to stay still! But I'm tense all over. Please hold me steady... And don't let Sakaguchi see how badly I'm shaking.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: “O-okay, I'll cooperate. The local anesthetic helps, but I know exactly what's in your hands. How am I supposed to be completely relaxed?”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: “I know my legs aren’t responding properly because of the anesthesia... But understanding it doesn’t stop me from panicking when I need someone else to hold me in position. I’m usually the one telling patients, ‘I’ve got you.’ Today I’m the one hanging on to you...”
reaction_lines.contact_pause: “Hah... thank you. Let me catch my breath. That last bit was a lot more intense than I expected... All right, don't rush me. I'm listening.”
reaction_lines.contact_command: “I know—stay still, relax, breathe slowly... Easy for you to say. I'm trying, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
reaction_lines.contact_continue: “...Mm. Go on. I just needed to complain for a moment. I didn't say you had to stand here waiting until I ran out of things to say.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: “So that's where we are... Once you explain it, I can follow the procedure in my head. It's just... my body isn't nearly as calm as my brain.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: “I'm okay... Oh, don't look at me like that! When you watch me with those worried eyes, it makes me want to cry even more.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “...Sakaguchi? Why did everyone go quiet? I know you're concentrating... but lying here listening to instruments clink without hearing a word is making my skin crawl.”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “It's really almost over? Don't just say that to cheer me up... At this point, ‘just a few more stitches’ sounds beautiful enough to make me cry.”
reaction_lines.closure_coach: “Okay, I'll keep still... Hah, take your time. Look at me—I'm a doctor, and I still need someone to talk me through getting stitched up.”
reaction_lines.closure_silent: “...We're already at the suturing stage, and you still won't say a word to me? Hmph. Once I'm off this table, I'm making you tell me about the whole operation from the beginning.”
reaction_lines.incision_marking_awake: “...You’re marking it already? After all that preparation, we’re finally almost at the incision, and I don’t feel relieved at all... Sakaguchi, tell me just before you make the cut, okay?”
reaction_lines.incision_marking_none: “W-wait, that’s just a marking, right? A minute ago I was complaining the preparation was taking too long... Now that you’re about to cut, why does it suddenly feel too fast? Let me catch my breath... Please.”
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: “...Ah, you've already made the incision? I can feel that you're working on me, but it's nothing like what I'd been imagining... Hah. So it's really started.”
reaction_lines.incise_local: “Ah—! That still startled me! The local anesthetic is doing something, but knowing the blade has actually touched me is worlds apart from watching beside the table.”
reaction_lines.incise_none: “Aah—!! Ow, that hurts! W-wait... Hah... Y-you really made the cut! I know I agreed to this, but that was just... Ngh, Sakaguchi, please be gentle!”

“...When I watched nurses do skin prep, it always seemed to take no time at all. Today you’re checking one area after another. I know it’s necessary, but I’m embarrassed and getting irritated... How much longer?”
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: “Hold on, that area isn't part of this surgical field, is it? If you're only extending it out of habit, could you spare me a little?”
“Hm? That part can be skipped too? Then I want to think about it. I'm here for surgery, not to sign up for the deluxe pre-op preparation package.”
ward_surgical_cap: “Please tuck all my hair in... Sigh. Once the cap is on, it really feels like I’m being sent off to the operating table. I was so confident when I agreed, so why is just looking at this cap making me nervous?”
“When I checked patients’ caps, I’d smile and say, ‘Don’t worry, it’ll be over soon’... Now it’s my turn, and all I want to ask is—when you say ‘soon,’ how long is that, exactly?”
operative_positioning_awake: “...Arm here, move my body a little more... I know, I know! You all usually call me Dr. Nanjou, but today you’re arranging me one by one, and I have to ask before I can even turn over... This is so humiliating.”
“D-don’t rush me! I am cooperating... But once I’m in position I can’t just move, and then I have to wait for you to finish. You have work to keep you busy; I’m counting every single minute!”
operative_positioning_none: “W-wait... Please don’t all crowd around at once! I know I need to cooperate especially carefully without anesthesia, but the more seriously you say ‘preparation,’ the more I panic... Give me a moment.”
“The straps too, huh... Mm, I know they're for safety. But once I'm settled like this, it really hits me—even if I wanted to shrink away, there's nowhere to go.”
urinary_catheterization_awake: “...So it’s my turn for this part, too. You’re all coworkers I see every day, and now I’m lying here needing this kind of help... Ah, don’t look at my face! I’m mortified!”
“Hah... I used to tell patients, with a perfectly straight face, ‘Just relax.’ If you say that to me one more time today, I really might get mad... I’m trying my best!”
urinary_catheterization_none: “H-hey, wait a second! I know what this step involves, but all this time I’ve been lying however you tell me to lie... And now I have to go through this part wide awake, too. I’m so embarrassed I can hardly face anyone!”
“Ah... wait... I really am trying to cooperate. But the more matter-of-fact you all are, the more I feel like a patient whose every move has been decided for her... Ugh, this is mortifying.”
skin_disinfection_awake: “Cold! ...Oh, it's the antiseptic. I know, I know. But hearing patients react from beside the table and jumping at the touch yourself are two completely different things.”

“...We’re not finished yet? I know skin disinfection can’t be rushed, but after all that preparation in the ward, it feels like I’ve been waiting here on the table forever... You’re all busy doing things, while I just stare at the surgical lights and scare myself half to death.”
skin_disinfection_none: “...It's only skin prep. Why is my heart pounding already? Sakaguchi, when you really make the cut, you're not allowed to laugh at me.”

“Wait for the antiseptic to dry, drape the field, do the checks... I know, none of it can be skipped. But lying here doing nothing, I’m actually starting to wish you’d hurry up and make the cut... Wait, what?! Last time it hurt terribly when you cut into me! Why am I even saying that?!”

contact_pain_incision_01.prompt: ...Ah, I felt that at the incision. Sakaguchi, we've really started, haven't we? I know the procedure, so why is my heart racing like this...?

responses.explain_contact: Mm, I'm listening. Slow breaths, just like you said, right? ...So today I'm the one being coached by the doctor.
responses.brief_contact: I know, we're following the plan... I'll stay still. It's just much more real than I imagined.
responses.continue_contact: ...All right, I'll cooperate. Just don't expect me to act like the Dr. Nanjou who can watch an operation without batting an eye.

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_01.prompt: Aah! W-wait, Sakaguchi! I knew the first incision would hurt, but why does it have to feel so horribly sharp and real...?!

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_01: Hah... I'm listening. Just go a little slower. I can't pretend to be brave right now; let me catch my breath...
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_01: You make it sound so easy to endure... Ngh! I know we have to keep going, but don't complain about how loudly I scream!

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_02.prompt: N-no... Are you going deeper already?! I haven't even recovered from that last part!

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_02: Hah... Just a moment's pause helps. Once I've stopped shaking, tell me what comes next, okay?
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_02: Aaah! Hey, Sakaguchi! It's easy for you to say 'keep going' when I'm the one lying here feeling every bit of it!

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_03.prompt: Sakaguchi... Ngh, I know I was the one who said no anesthesia, but it hurts so much now. Not even a little...?

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_03: ...No? All right, I understand... Then at least go slowly and tell me what you're about to do next, okay?
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_03: Ngh... Not even a moment to recover...?! I know you have to finish, but it hurts so much I could cry!

contact_default_01.prompt: ...Huh? We've started already? You're all so practiced I almost missed it. Just because I'm a doctor too doesn't mean you can skip telling me.

responses.reassure_start: Mm, that's reassuring. I'm your patient today, so remember to keep me informed.
responses.brief_start: All right, got it... Sigh. Even though I’ve been through this before, hearing “we’ve started” while I’m on the table still makes me nervous.
responses.silent_start: ...All right, I'll be quiet. I'm very good at cooperating... Or at least I'll try.

contact_pain_incision_02.prompt: Ah... I can feel the incision so clearly now. Sakaguchi, you can hear me, right? I haven't got the energy to keep pretending I'm calm today.

responses.acknowledge_second_contact: Mm, hearing you answer helps. Can you keep talking to me? It doesn't have to be much. Just a word now and then.
responses.brief_second_contact: Okay, you're still there... Hah. Then I'll hang on a little longer.

contact_fear_incision_01.prompt: ...Have you really made the incision? Not being able to see your hands makes me imagine all kinds of things. Don't laugh, Sakaguchi. I'm never frightened when I'm the one operating.

responses.orient_fearful_contact: Oh, so that's as far as you've gone... I understand. Tell me when you're about to do the next step too, okay?
responses.steady_fearful_contact: Mm... I'm listening to your voice. Breathe in slowly... Okay, at least I know you haven't left me alone.
responses.dismiss_fearful_contact: ...All right, I won't ask again. But I am scared, and don't scold me if I end up crying out.

responses.explain_progress: Oh... so it's still a planned step. Thanks for explaining. Otherwise I'd have imagined every worst-case scenario by now.
responses.brief_progress: Mm, so we're still on track... I understand. Just don't all go silent on me like that next time.
responses.dismiss_progress: ...All right, I won't distract you. But I really am frightened. Please don't treat that as a pointless complaint.

progress_default_01.prompt: Sakaguchi, how far along are we? The harder I try to work it out like a doctor, the more I realize I have no sense of time down here.

responses.answer_progress: Oh, so that part's finished. Hah... Hearing an actual update suddenly gives me something to look forward to.
responses.brief_answer_progress: Okay, stay with the plan. I trust you... Just don't leave me staring at the surgical lights and guessing forever.

cardiac_progress_fear_01.prompt: ...Are you working on my heart already? The quieter everyone gets, the more nervous I feel—and I usually love a quiet OR.

responses.explain_cardiac_progress: Mm, still the planned stage... Good. Just say something now and then, please, so I don't have to interpret every sound myself.
responses.brief_cardiac_progress: ...Understood. I'll try not to distract anyone. Just don't all forget I'm here, okay?

responses.explain_fatigue_progress: Oh, so that's the stage... As long as nothing went wrong. Hah, I really don't want you skipping steps just to save time.
responses.brief_fatigue_progress: Still on plan... okay, I trust you. But once I'm off the table, you have to let me complain about how long I've been lying here.

cabg_signature_01.prompt: ...I just heard 'anastomosis.' Sakaguchi, you're really making a new route for blood to reach my heart... It still sounds unbelievable.

responses.brief_cabg_milestone: ...Understood. I trust you all... This is just far more frightening than I imagined.

responses.coach_strain: Okay... in, then breathe out slowly... I'm trying, but my body isn't nearly as obedient as my brain.
responses.push_through_strain: ...I know. I'll try not to move... But when I'm off this table, you're going to hear exactly how miserable that was!

responses.coach_abdominal_strain: Hah... breathe out slowly, right? Okay, I'll hold on... My abdomen really isn't listening to me.

responses.coach_second_traction: Mm... breathe out slowly, try not to tense up so much... I’m trying. Ugh, why can’t my body listen to me for once?

responses.ignore_exposure: ...You say not to mind? Hey, I'm not trying to make trouble for anyone! I'm genuinely embarrassed today.

field.speaker: explainer
field.text: “This is a vaginal hysterectomy. Unlike an open abdominal procedure, we won't begin with an incision in your abdomen. We'll expose the cervix through the vaginal approach, work through the tissue planes around it, address the supporting structures and uterine blood vessels, and remove the uterus vaginally. After that we'll check for bleeding and close the vaginal cuff. The bladder and rectum are close to the operative field, so we'll identify and protect them carefully throughout. Once you've chosen an anesthesia method, we'll go over what you might feel if you're awake.”

bowel.speaker: patient
bowel.text: “G-good heavens... you're really going to make the incision down there?! I know perfectly well what a vaginal procedure is, but now that it's *me*... Sakaguchi, oh no, you're going to see the anatomy down there in every little detail... D-don't laugh! I'm asking a serious question! ...And aren't the bladder and rectum right next to it? Will you have to push my intestines aside too?”

bowel_answer.speaker: explainer
bowel_answer.text: “We won't need to move the intestines extensively to establish an abdominal operative field the way we would in an open procedure. This operation is approached vaginally, following the tissue planes around the cervix. We'll still watch the deeper anatomy and its relation to the abdominal cavity, especially protecting the bladder and rectum. How much traction or pressure you might feel depends on the anesthesia you choose next. We'll confirm that with you before we begin.”

bladder.speaker: patient
bladder.text: “...So you won't push the intestines up first. You'll carefully separate the bladder from the front of my cervix... I've explained that step to patients myself, and it always sounded so routine. But now someone else is telling me that instruments will go in down there, and it'll be *my* cervix they're going to hold and pull... Why does just thinking about it frighten me so much?”

manipulator.speaker: explainer
manipulator.text: “With the vaginal approach, we mainly use instruments to grasp the cervix and apply downward traction, adjusting the direction as needed to expose the tissue planes in front and behind. We don't simply push the uterus upward from below. We'll separate the bladder along the correct plane and protect the rectum as well. You're familiar with these steps from your work, but today you're the patient. If anything is unclear or worries you, you can keep asking.”

ward_visit_opening.speaker: narrator
ward_visit_opening.text: 推开单人病房的门，平日里总是身披笔挺白大褂的阿尔托莉雅已经换上了浅蓝色的住院病号服，正端正地坐在床沿，将换下的衣物叠得方方正正。

ward_visit_opening.speaker: patient
ward_visit_opening.text: 「你来了，坂口君。明明这间病房我查房时走过无数回，可一旦脱下白大褂坐到病床上，连空气闻起来都变得不一样了呢。」

ward_visit_opening.speaker: player
ward_visit_opening.text: 「副部长大人现在还来得及反悔哦？待会儿进了手术室，我可就真的拿你当普通患者严格要求了。」

ward_visit_opening.speaker: patient
ward_visit_opening.text: 「我才不会临阵脱逃呢。从现在起没有外科副部长，只有你的患者阿尔托莉雅——请按正式流程开始术前准备吧，坂口医生。」

stage_prompts.graphic_preop_question: 「坂口医生，在你开始讲解之前，我想以患者身份确认三件事——今天计划的解剖游离边界在哪里、术中需要我如何配合呼吸与体位，以及术后引流管的留置方案是什么？」

reaction_lines.hospitalization_question: 「在患者姓名栏里看到『阿尔托莉雅·潘德拉贡』这几个字，感觉比签十份高危手术同意书还要奇妙……坂口医生，我的入院手续都核对无误了吗？」
reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: 「明白。医局和排班表的事我已经全部交接妥当了，住院期间我不会插手任何科务，专心做一名合格的患者。」
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: 「……请等一下，坂口医生。器械台刚才备好的包和体位要求，跟我们在病房约定的术式不一致——作为主刀，请你先把临时变更方案的医学理由向我解释清楚。」
reaction_lines.explain_plan: 「即便我熟悉外科教材上的每一个步骤，今天躺在这里的人也是我。坂口医生，请不要因为我的职务而省略细节，像对待其他患者一样把手术方案完整告诉我吧。」
reaction_lines.brief_plan: 「……很精炼的说明呢。差点就习惯性地想替你补充解剖层次的注意事项了……咳，我已经明白大致方向了，听你安排，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.last_reassure: 「嗯，我的心跳已经平复下来了。不管是接下来的刀锋还是漫长的缝合，我都交给坂口医生和大家了。」
reaction_lines.choose_general: 「全身麻醉吗……也好，这样我就彻底没法隔着布帘偷听你们的器械声、更没法违规指挥了。等我再睁开眼睛的时候，希望第一眼就能看到你，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: 「硬膜外阻滞啊……平时我总是在别人背后穿刺置管的那个人，轮到自己清醒着感受下半身一点点变得麻木沉重，还真有些微妙的不安呢。请多关照，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.choose_local: 「局部浸润麻醉……也就是说表皮的锐痛会被阻断，但深部筋膜的牵拉和器械触感我都会清清楚楚地感觉到对吧？……我做好心理准备了，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.choose_none: 「……不采用任何麻醉吗？坂口医生，身为外科医生，我比谁都清楚这意味着怎样直接的创伤与痛楚……但既然这是我们共同确认的决定，我绝不会在台上退缩的。」
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: 「面罩里的氧气很温和……眼皮已经开始发沉了……坂口医生，还有大家，接下来就拜托你们了……」
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: 「不需要再追加麻药了，坂口医生。我的手指已经握紧床沿了……不管有多痛，我都会咬紧牙关忍住，请直接按计划开始吧！」
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: 「唔……！抱、抱歉，没有麻醉的情况下身体还是会本能地绷紧发抖……谢谢你按住我的肩膀，这样感觉踏实多了。」
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: 「谢谢你帮我扶稳体位……局麻下还是能感觉到台面的震动，有人在肩侧托着会更容易集中精神配合。」
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: 「劳烦你了……阻滞平面上来之后，腰腿完全使不上力气，连稳住重心都要靠大家帮忙，稍微有点难为情呢。」
reaction_lines.incision_ready: 「……刚才那声脆响，是器械护士把圆刀递到你手里的声音吧，坂口医生。明明平时在台上听过无数次，可感觉到刀尖悬在自己皮肤正上方的时候，心跳还是快得藏不住……请、请下刀吧。」
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: 「嗯……！没有尖锐的痛感，但刀刃划开皮肤和皮下组织的紧绷震动，还是清清楚楚地传过来了……坂口医生的起刀很稳，请继续。」
reaction_lines.incise_local: 「嘶……っ！表皮不痛，但切到深层筋膜的时候还是有一阵发酸发胀的钝痛……没、没关系，呼吸还能稳住，请继续推进吧，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.incise_none: 「唔啊……っ！哈、哈啊……好烫、像被烧红的剑刃直接剖开一样……っ！不、不用停，坂口医生……我能撑住，别让我的防卫性肌紧张耽误你的层次……！」
reaction_lines.contact_pause: 「哈啊……哈啊……谢谢你，坂口医生。稍微停下这几秒钟让我把气喘匀，冷汗就没那么厉害了……」
reaction_lines.contact_command: 「……是！对不起，我不乱动了……我跟着你的口令慢慢呼气，请继续操作，坂口医生！」
reaction_lines.contact_continue: 「……我已经把呼吸调整好了，坂口医生。不用顾虑我，请继续往下做吧。」
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: 「听着你报出解剖层次的声音，哪怕看不见术野，我也能在脑海里拼出你手下的画面……很稳健的节奏，听到你这么说我就放心了。」
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: 「隔着无菌布帘看到你的眼睛……刚才攒在胸口的那点慌乱一下子就安静下来了。我没事的，坂口医生。」
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: 「……坂口医生？台上好一会儿只有持针器和止血钳碰撞的声音……是深部游离遇到粘连了吗？如果方便的话，跟我说句话好不好……」
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: 「终于到逐层关闭切口和缝合的阶段了吗……呼……听见这句，紧绷了半天的脊背总算敢真正贴回手术台面上了。」
reaction_lines.closure_coach: 「嗯……吸气……再慢慢呼气……配合缝合放松肌肉张力的要领我还记得，只是体力有点见底了……我会乖乖跟着你的节奏的。」
reaction_lines.closure_silent: 「哈啊……眼皮好重，连手指都快没力气动了……坂口医生……还剩最后几针皮内缝合对吗……我就在这里安静等你收尾……」

ward_enema: 「术前肠道清洁的重要性我当然明白……只是平时都是我给患者开医嘱，轮到自己提起病号服侧躺下来接受灌肠，哪怕面对的是熟悉的护士，耳根还是忍不住发烫啊……」
「唔……温热的液体推进来的时候，下腹那种不断膨胀的坠胀感实在让人很难维持平时的端庄……请、请让我抓着床栏再坚持五分钟，我一定严格按标准排空……」
ward_enema_unnecessary: 「今天的术式不涉及下消化道与盆腔深部显露，按指南确实不需要常规灌肠……咳，我纯粹是从循证医学角度赞同你的决定，绝对不是暗自松了一口气哦，坂口医生。」
「省去术前灌肠了吗？既然不影响无菌视野与肠管减压，能少受一道罪，作为患者我还是坦率向你说声谢谢吧，坂口医生。」
ward_skin_prep: 「备皮刀贴在皮肤上沙沙移动的触感，比想象中还要痒、还要让人害羞呢……平时在台上只觉得术野干净理所当然，自己躺着才体会到患者有多不自在。」
「请放心按标准范围刮干净吧。为了杜绝术后切口感染，毛发清理绝不能马虎——我闭上眼睛不看就是了，唔……」
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: 「那个……坂口医生，以今天的切口路径来说，刚才备皮剃除的范围是不是稍微超出无菌规范要求的边界了……？虽、虽然听凭你处置，但也请稍微顾及一下我的体面呀。」
「连那里也要一并备皮吗……？明明不是主切口经过的区域……唔，既然你坚持是为了扩大无菌备用的安全余量，那我就乖乖躺好不动了。」

ward_visit_opening.speaker: narrator
ward_visit_opening.text: When the door to the private ward opens, Artoria--who normally wears a crisp white coat--has already changed into a pale blue hospital gown, sitting upright on the edge of the bed with her folded clothes neatly stacked beside her.

ward_visit_opening.speaker: patient
ward_visit_opening.text: "You are here, Sakaguchi-kun. I have walked into this ward countless times on rounds, yet once I take off my white coat and sit on the hospital bed, even the air feels completely different."

ward_visit_opening.speaker: player
ward_visit_opening.text: "It is not too late for the Deputy Chief to back out, you know? Once we step into the operating room, I really will treat you strictly as an ordinary patient."

ward_visit_opening.speaker: patient
ward_visit_opening.text: "I would never retreat at the last moment. From now on, there is no Deputy Chief of Surgery here, only your patient Artoria--please begin the preoperative preparations according to formal protocol, Dr. Sakaguchi."

stage_prompts.graphic_preop_question: "Dr. Sakaguchi, before you begin the briefing, I would like to confirm three things as your patient--what are the planned boundaries of anatomical dissection today, how do you need me to coordinate my breathing and posture during the procedure, and what is the plan for postoperative drainage?"

reaction_lines.hospitalization_question: "Seeing 'Artoria Pendragon' written in the patient column feels stranger than signing ten high-risk surgical consent forms... Dr. Sakaguchi, are all my admission papers in order?"
reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: "Understood. I have handed over all department duties and shift schedules, and I will not interfere with any staff matters while admitted. I will focus entirely on being a proper patient."
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: "...Please wait a moment, Dr. Sakaguchi. The instrument tray and positioning setup do not match the procedure we agreed upon in the ward--as primary surgeon, please explain the clinical reason for changing the plan first."
reaction_lines.explain_plan: "Even if I know every step in the surgical textbook, I am the one lying on the table today. Please do not omit details on account of my title, Dr. Sakaguchi--explain the surgical plan to me in full just as you would for any other patient."
reaction_lines.brief_plan: "...That was a very concise explanation. I nearly slipped into my old habit of adding anatomical precautions for you... Ahem, I understand the general plan and will follow your lead, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.last_reassure: "Yes, my pulse has steadied now. Both the scalpel ahead and the long closure to come--I leave everything to you and the team, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.choose_general: "General anesthesia... Perhaps that is for the best, so I cannot eavesdrop on the instruments behind the drape or issue unauthorized orders. When I open my eyes again, I hope yours is the first face I see, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: "Epidural blockade... I am usually the one placing the catheter behind the patient's back. Feeling my own lower body grow numb and heavy while remaining wide awake makes me unexpectedly uneasy. Please take care of me, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.choose_local: "Local infiltration anesthesia... That means superficial sharp pain will be blocked, but I will clearly feel every deep fascial traction and instrument movement, right? ...I am mentally prepared, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.choose_none: "...Without any anesthesia at all? Dr. Sakaguchi, as a surgeon I know better than anyone what kind of raw trauma and pain that entails... Yet since we made this decision together, I will not flinch on the table."
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: "The oxygen inside the mask feels gentle... My eyelids are already growing heavy... Dr. Sakaguchi, everyone, I am in your hands..."
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: "There is no need to add anesthesia, Dr. Sakaguchi. My fingers are gripping the edge of the table... No matter how intense the pain, I will clench my teeth and endure it, so please proceed as planned!"
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: "Ugh...! F-forgive me, without anesthesia my body still tenses and trembles by reflex... Thank you for steadying my shoulders, that helps me feel much more grounded."
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: "Thank you for helping stabilize my posture... Under local anesthesia I can still feel the vibrations across the table, so having support by my shoulder makes it easier to stay focused."
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: "Thank you for the trouble... Now that the epidural level has set in, I have no strength in my waist or legs at all. Having to rely on everyone just to keep my balance is a little embarrassing."
reaction_lines.incision_ready: "...That crisp metallic sound just now was the scrub nurse placing the scalpel into your hand, wasn't it, Dr. Sakaguchi? I have heard it countless times at the table, yet feeling the blade hover right above my own skin makes my heart race... P-please make the incision."
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: "Mm...! There is no sharp pain, yet the taut vibration of the blade parting skin and subcutaneous tissue still travels clearly through me... Your first stroke is very steady, Dr. Sakaguchi. Please continue."
reaction_lines.incise_local: "Tch... ah! The epidermis does not hurt, but cutting into the deeper fascia brings a dull, aching pull... I-it is fine, my breathing is steady, please keep advancing, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.incise_none: "Ngh... ah! Haa, haa... It burns, as if a searing blade just split me open directly...! D-do not stop, Dr. Sakaguchi... I can hold on, do not let my muscle guarding slow down your dissection planes...!"
reaction_lines.contact_pause: "Haa... haa... Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi. Giving me just these few seconds to catch my breath eases the cold sweat so much..."
reaction_lines.contact_command: "...Yes! Forgive me, I will hold completely still... I will follow your count and exhale slowly, please continue, Dr. Sakaguchi!"
reaction_lines.contact_continue: "...I have steadied my breathing now, Dr. Sakaguchi. Do not worry about me--please continue the dissection."
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: "Hearing you call out the anatomical planes lets me picture the field in my mind even behind the drape... Your rhythm is rock-solid. Hearing your voice puts me at ease."
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: "Meeting your eyes past the sterile drape... all that tension knotted in my chest quieted down in an instant. I am alright, Dr. Sakaguchi."
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: "...Dr. Sakaguchi? For a long while now there has only been the clinking of needle holders and hemostats... Did you run into dense adhesions deep down? If you can spare a breath, please say a word to me..."
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: "Have we finally reached layer-by-layer closure and suturing...? Phew... Hearing that, my back can finally relax against the operating table after staying rigid for so long."
reaction_lines.closure_coach: "Mm... inhale... and slowly exhale... I still remember the rule about relaxing muscle tension during closure, though my stamina is nearly spent... I will follow your rhythm dutifully."
reaction_lines.closure_silent: "Haa... My eyelids feel so heavy, I barely have the strength to move my fingers... Dr. Sakaguchi... only a few subcuticular stitches left, right...? I will wait quietly right here until you finish..."

ward_enema: "Of course I understand the importance of preoperative bowel preparation... Yet I am usually the one writing the orders. Having to lift my gown and lie on my side for an enema myself--even with a familiar nurse--still makes my ears burn..."

"Mm... As the warm fluid flows in, this mounting pressure and cramping in my lower abdomen makes it terribly hard to keep my usual composure... P-please let me grip the bed rail and hold on for five more minutes, I will evacuate strictly according to protocol..."
ward_enema_unnecessary: "Today's procedure does not involve the lower gastrointestinal tract or deep pelvic exposure, so skipping routine enema is indeed consistent with guidelines... Ahem, I am merely agreeing on evidence-based grounds, not breathing a secret sigh of relief, Dr. Sakaguchi."
"Skipping the preoperative enema? Since it will not compromise the sterile field or bowel decompression, as a patient I will honestly thank you for sparing me one ordeal, Dr. Sakaguchi."
ward_skin_prep: "The rustling touch of the prep razor gliding across my skin is both more ticklish and far more embarrassing than I imagined... Standing at the table I took a clean surgical field for granted, yet lying here myself shows me how exposed a patient feels."
"Please shave the entire standard boundary cleanly. To prevent postoperative surgical site infection, hair removal must never be half-hearted--I will simply keep my eyes closed, mm..."
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: "Um... Dr. Sakaguchi, given today's incision pathway, does the area being shaved right now not extend somewhat beyond the required sterile boundary...? E-even though I placed myself in your hands, please spare a thought for my dignity."
"Must that area be shaved as well...? That is clearly outside the primary incision path... Mm, if you insist it is for an extra margin of sterile safety, I will lie still and comply."
ward_surgical_cap: "Normally, putting on a disposable cap before entering the OR means taking up the scalpel for battle; tucking all my braided hair into this blue patient cap today feels like a quiet reminder that I must surrender everything to others now."

"Even the stray hairs along my forehead are tucked inside the cap. Seeing myself in the mirror wearing only a hospital gown and surgical cap without a trace of makeup finally makes it sink in that I am today's surgical patient."
operative_positioning_awake: "The operating table feels much harder and colder than when I stand beside it in a sterile gown... Once both arms are extended and strapped to the armboards, I truly cannot shift even half an inch on my own."

"The angle of the positioning pads fits well and supports my lower back. Still, lying flat and defenseless directly beneath the shadowless lamp makes my breathing turn shallow despite my complete trust in all of you."
operative_positioning_none: "Securing my limbs and torso directly to the table without any anesthetic protection at all... Ugh, the moment the straps tightened around my wrists, every hair down my spine stood on end... I will do my utmost not to thrash on the table."
"My posture is aligned as you asked, Dr. Sakaguchi. Just thinking that I must endure every incision and retraction wide awake on this pad makes my fingertips clench the armboards tightly..."
urinary_catheterization_awake: "Ngh...! I know perfectly well that an indwelling catheter is essential to monitor renal perfusion and prevent bladder distension... Yet parting my legs to be catheterized in front of Dr. Sakaguchi and my own staff is still mortifying beyond words..."

"Haa... I can feel the dull pressure of the balloon inflating inside my bladder... I have ordered catheterization for countless patients, yet lying here watching the drainage bag hung by the rail shows me how much courage it takes..."
urinary_catheterization_none: "Ah... ngh! W-without any anesthetic numbing, every inch of the catheter sliding against the urethral mucosa feels terrifyingly vivid...! F-forgive me, Dr. Sakaguchi, I did not mean to tense my thighs, I will relax my breathing right now..."
"Tch... haa... It stings with a sharp, aching urge to void... So this is what unanesthetized catheterization feels like... Mm, as long as drainage is clear, please proceed to the next step..."
skin_disinfection_awake: "Mm... When the povidone-iodine sponge first touched my skin, the chill still made me flinch slightly. Your spiral strokes outward from the incision center are textbook-perfect... Even I could not find a single flaw."

"The cool antiseptic slowly evaporates across my skin, filling the air with its sharp scent. Every pass of the sponge brings the actual blade one step closer... Can you hear my heartbeat from over there?"
skin_disinfection_none: "Ah... so cold...! Without anesthesia to dull my nerves, the icy iodine brushing over my taut skin feels like a preview of the scalpel's path... Dr. Sakaguchi, my palms are completely drenched in sweat..."

"One pass, two passes, three passes... The wider the antiseptic spreads, the faster my breath catches... I know it is only a sponge, yet my body is already bracing in primal fear of the live blade..."
incision_marking_awake: "The faint tickle of the skin marker gliding across my skin is crystal clear... Judging from the length and trajectory of your stroke, Dr. Sakaguchi, you have balanced anatomical exposure and cosmetic closure admirably."

"Having a purple surgical incision line drawn across my own body... Where that ink rests will become a real wound in moments. I will close my eyes and breathe deeply--you may drape and begin whenever ready, Dr. Sakaguchi."
incision_marking_none: "Ngh...! The instant the marker tip touched my skin, I thought the scalpel had already come down and nearly held my breath... So it was only the skin marker... I must look terribly jumpy to you, Dr. Sakaguchi."

"As the marker tip traces inch by inch along the planned incision path, it does not hurt at all, yet knowing that a sharp blade will follow this exact line next makes my muscles clench involuntarily..."

responses.explain_contact: "Phew... haa... So you have already passed cleanly through the dermis. Thank you for reminding me, Dr. Sakaguchi--I will exhale slowly and keep my muscles from tensing against your plane."
responses.brief_contact: "...Understood. As long as everything is proceeding according to plan, I can endure this level of pain without issue. Please continue, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.continue_contact: "Yes...! Forgive me, I will stay focused. My hands are gripping the armboards steadily--please continue the dissection."

responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_01: "Ngh...! I understand--hesitating mid-incision is the worst thing a surgeon can do... I will clench my teeth and bear it, Dr. Sakaguchi. Ignore my trembling and cut cleanly to the target depth...!"

responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_02: "Mm...! Do not stop on my account, Dr. Sakaguchi! My back is flat against the operating table--as long as your scalpel is steady, I will not budge a fraction of an inch!"

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_03.prompt: "Ugh... haa... Dr. Sakaguchi... When the deep fascia is cut directly with scissors, my entire body shudders by instinct... Are we truly... going all the way to the end without anesthesia...?"

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_03: "...Mm, you are right. Since we resolved to proceed without anesthesia before starting, we must not falter halfway. Thank you for easing the traction slightly... I have steadied myself now, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_03: "...Yes! That was only a fleeting moment of bodily weakness speaking... I have regained control of my breathing. Please continue with the unanesthetized plan, Dr. Sakaguchi!"

responses.reassure_start: "Hearing you confirm that both my vitals and the incision plane are stable puts my mind completely at ease. I nearly asked for the estimated blood loss out of sheer habit... Please continue."
responses.brief_start: "Understood. Just hearing the certainty in your voice tells me the initial incision went smoothly."
responses.silent_start: "...Forgive me, I promised to be a quiet and obedient patient on the table today. I will keep silent and focus on my breathing, Dr. Sakaguchi."

responses.acknowledge_second_contact: "So you are setting the self-retaining retractor in place... Phew, knowing that this tension is a planned and necessary step makes it much easier to bear. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.brief_second_contact: "Alright... Since it is all going according to plan, I will keep my torso relaxed. Please proceed."

contact_fear_incision_01.prompt: "With the sterile drape blocking my view, all I can hear is the crisp click of hemostats locking... Dr. Sakaguchi, was that sound just now the ligation of the superficial vessels?"

responses.orient_fearful_contact: "I see... Hearing you name the exact step you just completed fills in the blank behind the drape right away. Lying on this side of the table, the primary surgeon's voice truly is the best reassurance."
responses.steady_fearful_contact: "Mm... I will stop trying to guess every instrument sound and simply focus on your voice and my breathing rhythm..."
responses.dismiss_fearful_contact: "...Forgive me, my old surgeon's habit of wanting to track every step on the table slipped out again. I will stop asking and leave everything to you, Dr. Sakaguchi."

progress_fear_default_01.prompt: "Dr. Sakaguchi... The shadow of the operating lamp against the drape has barely shifted, and I have lost track of how much time has passed... Is the procedure progressing smoothly?"

responses.explain_progress: "Every layer is advancing right on schedule... What a relief. Lying on the surface of the table makes time feel several times longer than when holding the scalpel."
responses.brief_progress: "Mm, as long as I know you are advancing steadily, I will not let my thoughts wander. Thank you for your hard work, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.dismiss_progress: "...Understood. A primary surgeon focusing on deep dissection should not be distracted. I will regulate my breathing quietly, Dr. Sakaguchi."

progress_default_01.prompt: "I just heard the exchange of long-handled instruments and warm saline laparotomy pads... Dr. Sakaguchi, which anatomical stage have we reached now?"

responses.answer_progress: "Just where I estimated we would be. Your anatomical planes are always so clean--knowing we have reached this point sets my heart completely at rest."
responses.brief_answer_progress: "As long as everything is on schedule, that is all I need to hear. I will keep playing my part as a cooperative patient, Dr. Sakaguchi."

progress_fear_fatigue_01.prompt: "Haa... Holding the exact same fixed posture on the table for so long has left my back and shoulders stiff and heavy... Dr. Sakaguchi, how much further until the core step is complete...?"

responses.explain_fatigue_progress: "More than halfway through already...? Phew, hearing you lay out the remaining steps so clearly gives me a fresh second wind. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.brief_fatigue_progress: "Mm... Since we are right on track, this bit of fatigue is nothing. I can still hold on, Dr. Sakaguchi."

progress_fear_fatigue_02.prompt: "Every breath feels heavier now, and even the sound of instruments being passed feels a little distant... Dr. Sakaguchi, have we passed the most critical hurdle yet...?"

responses.mark_fatigue_milestone: "Thank goodness... Hearing you mark such a clear milestone feels like spotting a signpost on a long march... I will see this through to the very end."
responses.encourage_fatigue_progress: "So the most demanding part is safely behind us... Phew... Hearing that finally lets my taut nerves breathe a little easier. I leave the remainder to you, Dr. Sakaguchi."

cardiac_progress_fear_01.prompt: "The pressure of the sternal retractor holding my chest open feels so heavy... as if my own heartbeat is laid bare to the air... Dr. Sakaguchi, are the pericardium and great vessels alright?"

responses.explain_cardiac_progress: "Phew... Hearing you report the cardiac exposure and hemodynamic stability so clearly calms the primal dread of having my chest opened. I expected nothing less of you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.brief_cardiac_progress: "Mm... As long as your hands inside my chest remain steady, I entrust every beat of my heart to you."

cardiac_progress_default_01.prompt: "Dr. Sakaguchi, I just felt an exquisitely fine traction deep within my mediastinum... Have you entered the core cardiac phase now?"

responses.answer_cardiac_progress: "So we have reached the most delicate stage after all. I will not dare take a single abrupt breath--I will keep my respiratory excursion as steady as possible to support you."
responses.brief_cardiac_answer: "Understood. Proceeding according to plan is what matters most. I will remain completely still, Dr. Sakaguchi."

thoracic_progress_fatigue_01.prompt: "Haa... With one side of my thorax open, every inhalation feels so much heavier than usual... Dr. Sakaguchi, how far along is the intrathoracic dissection...?"

responses.explain_thoracic_progress: "So the hilar and mediastinal dissection is nearly complete... Knowing the exact anatomical progress eases that suffocating panic in my chest so much. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
responses.brief_thoracic_progress: "Alright... Since everything is going smoothly, I will keep breathing shallowly and evenly so mediastinal shift never disturbs your field."

vascular_progress_deep_01.prompt: "That deep, firm pressure just now... Did the atraumatic vascular clamp just occlude the main vessel, Dr. Sakaguchi? Are the clamp time and distal perfusion holding steady?"

responses.explain_vascular_milestone: "Clean clamp placement and well within the safe ischemia window... Phew, even though I am the patient on the table, hearing such textbook vascular control makes me want to applaud you."
responses.brief_vascular_milestone: "Understood. With you watching the clamp clock, I will set aside unnecessary worries--please focus entirely on the vascular anastomosis."

cabg_signature_01.prompt: "Dr. Sakaguchi... I can sense the finest suture tension right in the center of my chest... Are you performing the coronary artery bypass graft anastomosis right now?"

responses.explain_cabg_milestone: "Good target vessel exposure and brisk graft flow...? Having this performed on my own heart while hearing you confirm it fills my chest with an indescribable mix of awe and relief."
responses.brief_cabg_milestone: "Mm... Knowing the critical coronary anastomosis is right on schedule is enough. I will keep my breathing whisper-soft so my chest wall does not move a hair."

strain_pain_default_01.prompt: "Ngh...! Dr. Sakaguchi, when the deep retractor pulls outward, a heavy, aching pain shoots straight up into my spine...!"

responses.pause_strain: "Haa... haa... Thank you for easing the retractor tension slightly and explaining the cause... Deep tissue referred pain truly cannot be reasoned away, and those two seconds helped immensely."
responses.coach_strain: "Mm... inhale... and slowly exhale... Following your rhythm to relax my rigid torso really does dull that heavy pulling sensation from deep inside."
responses.push_through_strain: "...Yes! I know that without sufficient retraction, the deep surgical field cannot be exposed safely... I will grit my teeth and endure it, so please do not reduce your exposure, Dr. Sakaguchi!"

strain_default_01.prompt: "Mm... I just felt a distinct tugging deep inside that made my breath catch... Dr. Sakaguchi, are you mobilizing the deep ligaments right now?"

responses.explain_strain: "So it really is the traction reflex from the deep ligaments and fascial planes... Hearing you confirm the source keeps my body from instinctively fighting the pull."
responses.brief_strain: "Alright. Knowing this traction will pass shortly lets me close my eyes and bear with it calmly."

abdominal_strain_pain_01.prompt: "Ugh... ah! Deep in my upper abdomen and epigastrium, it feels as though my organs are being gripped and pulled outward--cold sweat is breaking out across my forehead... Dr. Sakaguchi...!"

responses.explain_abdominal_strain: "Haa... So it is the vagal reflex from traction on the retroperitoneum and mesenteric root... I have told countless patients at the table not to tense up, yet tasting this churning visceral ache myself shows me just how grueling it is..."
responses.coach_abdominal_strain: "Mm... I am listening--do not hold my breath, do not bear down... Haa... I will let my abdominal wall soften bit by bit so the bowel never pushes into your field..."

responses.pause_second_traction: "Phew... haa... Thank you for letting me catch my breath... Sakaguchi-kun... ah, no, Dr. Sakaguchi... That pull just now nearly made me cry out, but I am ready to continue now."
responses.coach_second_traction: "Alright... I will breathe deeply to your count... As long as it helps you expose the deep anatomical plane cleanly, I will endure this traction to the end."

strain_pain_pressure_01.prompt: "Ngh... There is a heavy, crushing pressure resting directly against my deep organs, as if a whole hand and laparotomy pad are pressing down... My chest feels tight, Dr. Sakaguchi..."

responses.relieve_pressure: "Haa... That pressure eased so much! Thank you for adjusting the angle of the packing pad and fulcrum--I can breathe freely again."
responses.explain_pressure: "So that downward pressure is necessary to tamponade oozing and shield adjacent organs... Understood. Since it is a protective maneuver, I will adapt to the weight."

urologic_strain_pressure_01.prompt: "Ngh...! A fierce, aching pressure is radiating deep through my flank and lower back, pulling all the way down toward my bladder... Dr. Sakaguchi, are you dissecting around the renal pedicle or ureter?"

responses.pause_urologic_strain: "Haa... Thank you for pausing half a beat. Retroperitoneal urologic traction really does travel straight into the deep lumbar nerves... I have steadied my posture now, please continue."
responses.explain_urologic_strain: "So it is the normal reflex from mobilizing Gerota's fascia and the ureteral pathway... Hearing your explanation keeps me from worrying that the urinary catheter is obstructed. Please proceed, Dr. Sakaguchi."

dignity_low_exposure_01.prompt: "Um... Dr. Sakaguchi, when the sterile drapes were folded back just now, I felt cool air brushing directly across my bare skin... Is the current exposure not a little wider than necessary...?"

responses.restore_cover: "Thank you for tucking the warm sterile towels back around the periphery of the field... Even though everyone here is a colleague I work with every day, lying bare under the operating lamp still makes my ears burn with embarrassment."
responses.explain_exposure: "...It is to leave sufficient sterile margin for manipulation and drain placement, is it? Speaking as a surgeon, I cannot fault that logic... I will simply close my eyes and try not to think about everyone watching."
responses.ignore_exposure: "Ugh... You have a point--on the operating table, personal modesty must give way to the procedure... I-I will redirect my focus back to my breathing, Dr. Sakaguchi."

dignity_default_01.prompt: "Even though I braced myself before the drapes were laid... clearly feeling so many familiar eyes focused on the exposed part of my body still makes my pulse race uncontrollably..."
